corrections.why: FFLA lists a standing tower at Patuxent River Park, but the DNR report says the Hollofield forestry tower was removed and its upper section went to Merkle NRMA; the sources conflict.

corrections.current: The tower still stands, but its cab is gone (FFLA).
corrections.proposed: Sources disagree: FFLA lists a Patuxent River Park tower as standing; a DNR report says the Hollofield tower was removed and its upper section is an observation platform at Merkle NRMA.
corrections.why: The DNR report places the upper section at Merkle NRMA, not Patuxent River Park, so the claim that the tower still stands there is not confirmed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA lists a Patuxent River Park tower as relocated from Hollofield and standing; the DNR report says the upper section without the cab is an observation platform at Merkle NRMA. Not resolved.

notes_for_editor: No build date, height or design found. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts Hollofield page gives only the name and county. FFLA and the DNR report disagree on the destination. Hill Hiker's demolished four-story tower at Patuxent River Park is not linked to Hollofield in any source read. Read budget exceeded by about four pages while checking the conflicts.
